description.title: תנאי פוליסת ניתוחים
description.summary: This table outlines the conditions for surgical insurance policies, detailing coverage eligibility based on pre-existing medical conditions and agreements with medical institutions. It specifies whether coverage applies when a surgery is performed with a doctor/institution that has an agreement with the insurance company.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת ניתוחים מספקת כיסוי עבור ניתוחים שבוצעו בישראל, בהתאם לתנאים המפורטים. הזכאות לכיסוי תלויה בקיום הסדר ניתוח עם המוסד הרפואי והרופא המבצע, לדוגמה, סעיף 4.10 מציין כי כיסוי ניתן רק אם קיים הסדר ניתוח. התשלומים בגין ניתוחים אלו מוגבלים לתקרת עלות הניתוח המוחלף.
description.row_axis: Insurance conditions related to pre-existing conditions and surgical agreements
notable_values: 4.9: Refers to contractual provisions regarding pre-existing medical conditions
4.10: Coverage is only provided if a surgical agreement exists with the medical institution and doctor
2004: Year referenced in a legal clause (תשס"ד)

This table outlines the conditions for surgical insurance policies, detailing coverage eligibility based on pre-existing medical conditions and agreements with medical institutions. It specifies whether coverage applies when a surgery is performed with a doctor/institution that has an agreement with the insurance company.
